run_f_gold: run f_gold to count adjacent equal elements in array within a given index range
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct counting of equal consecutive elements
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a more efficient approach for counting adjacent equal pairs in a range
review_f_gold: review f_gold which iterates from index l to r counting positions where a[i] equals a[i+1]
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that counts indices in range [l, r) where consecutive array elements are equal
